questions.q: You moved out wide. What happens next?
options: The forward runs back for the ball
The middle defender passes to you
You run back to the middle
questions.explain: Yes. You are open out wide, so the pass comes to you.
choiceExplanations: The forward stays ahead, and you are the open player out wide.
Yes. You are open out wide, so the pass comes to you.
Going back to the middle takes away the new outside route.
